title: Minesweeper
description: 1943. War drama starring Richard Arlen, Jean Parker & Russell Hayden. A former naval deserter is drawn back to the services after the attack on Pearl Harbour.

title: Talk About Jacqueline
description: 1942. Comedy. Director: Harold French & Paul L. Stein. Stars Hugh Williams & Carla Lehmann. A woman meets a researcher. When they marry, he runs across some scandalous gossip about her past.

title: Radio London 1967
description: A short promo film shot on board the Radio London pirate radio ship in summer 1967, shortly before the station's closure. DJ's seen include John Peel, Mark Roman, Pete Drummond and Willie Walker.

title: Legend of the Hidden City
description: Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Morgan plans to attack 'The Source'. Meanwhile, Ram declares war on Queen Kama and her people.

title: William Tell
description: 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop.

title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
description: 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Rodney Bunker. Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle.

title: The Lone Ranger
description: 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The Lone Ranger believes in Fred Vance and helps him settle during a war between the Madden gang and local ranches.

title: Supercar
description: 1961. Stars George Murcell & David Graham. While in Ireland, Dr. Beaker overhears a plan by two smugglers to kidnap the daughter of an innkeeper and alerts his friends back at base.

title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
description: 1957. Stars Richard Greene, John Sharplin & Patrick Troughton. A pair of villagers go to Robin's camp with news of an oppressive tax recently imposed by the greedy Count Olivier.

title: Biggles: Adventures in Time
description: 1986. Sci-Fi. Director: John Hough. Stars Peter Cushing, Neil Dickson, Alex Hyde-White. The daring flying ace takes on his arch rival aided by a British intelligence officer and a time traveller.

title: H.M.S Defiant
description: 1962. Drama. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Alec Guinness, Dirk Bogarde & Maurice Denham. During the French Revolutionary War, Captain Crawford is stuck in a battle of with his second in command.

title: Scales of Justice
description: Personal and Confidential. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Ellen McIntosh. Police investigating a suspicious death find a file marked 'Top Secret' in the victim's briefcase. (S1, E.

title: The Quatermass Xperiment
description: 1955. Horror. Director: Val Guest. Stars Brian Donlevy, Jack Warner & Thora Hird. A manned rocket ship returns to Earth with two astronauts missing and the survivor incapable of communicating.

title: Tell Me Another
description: 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Yootha Joyce, Bernard Manning, Alfred Marks, Leslie Phillips, Terry Scott & Max Wall.

title: Dick Turpin
description: 1982. Stars Richard O'Sullivan & Joan Sims. Glutton's Godmother, the Duchess of Durham comes to visit, and Sir John must convince her that he is married to become her heir.

title: Maigret
description: 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Francis De Wolff. Maigret investigates a strange accident, noticing that the men of the Paris canals do not take well to interference.

title: Lillie
description: 1978. Stars Francesca Annis, Jennie Linden & Peter Egan. In London, Lillie becomes a 'Professional Beauty' and a social sensation. She also meets Oscar Wilde and Princess Louise.

title: Prudence and the Pill
description: 1968. Comedy. Directed by Fielder Cook. Stars Deborah Kerr, David Niven & Judy Geeson. Five couples get involved in comical chaos when they swap birth control pills to deceive each other.

title: EuroTrash
description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. Tonight, we meet The Belgian Baldmen, get squashed in a squash court, then go back to nature in Germany and meet the German Pamela Anderson.

title: Around the World in 80 Raves
description: Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood & Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.

title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner
description: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Dandy Nichols. The adventures of an optimistic and inept window cleaner who finds other ways to satisfy his customers.

title: Rentadick
description: 1972. Comedy. Director: Jim Clark. Stars James Booth, Richard Briers & Julie Ege. The incompetent detectives of Rentadick Inc track thieves of a nerve gas that paralyses from the waist down.

title: The Girl On The Pier
description: 1953. Crime. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars Veronica Hurst, Ron Randell & Marjorie Rhodes. Rivalry between a Brighton crooner who has done time and his partner in crime, who is being blackmailed.

title: One Step Beyond
description: Make Me Not a Witch. 1959. Stars Patty McCormack & Robert Emhardt. A girl's parents are terrified when their daughter reveals that she can read minds. But her gift may be able to save lives.

title: Enter the Lone Ranger
description: 1949. Western. Directed by Geroge B. Seitz Jr. Stars Clayton Moore & Jay Silverheels. The sole surviving Texas Ranger of a murderous ambush becomes the great masked hero who fights for justice.

title: What's On TPTV With Noel
description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November.

title: The Super Secret Service
description: 1953. Comedy. Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'.

title: Paratrooper
description: 1954. War. Director: Terence Young. Stars Leo Genn, Alan Ladd & Harry Andrews. Distraught over his role in a tragic training accident, a US Air Force officer secretly enlists in the British Army.

title: Lest We Forget
description: An exclusive documentary commemorating the end of WWI. Presented by war historian Alan Forbes who visits the battlefields and memorials of Flanders and the Somme.

title: We Will Remember Them
description: We join the nation in paying tribute to the fallen. We honour our heroes with The Last Post.

title: Carve Her Name With Pride
description: 1958. War Drama. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Virginia McKenna, Paul Scofield & Jack Warner. Based on the true story of WW2 special agent Violette Szabo recruited to work as a spy in France.

title: Review No.1 29th Year (The Royal British Legion)
description: Take a look at what the Royal British Legion are doing to support their members and veterans of the British Armed Forces, also with a glimpse of the history of the charity.

title: Nine Men
description: 1943. War. Director: Harry Watt. Stars Gordon Jackson, Jack Lambert & Frederick Piper. British soldiers are attacked when travelling across the desolate wastes of WWII Libya.

title: That's My Boy
description: 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Janet Davies & Jenny Tomasin. Ida discovers that there are plans to open a home for unmarried mothers and Mrs. Cross starts a petition against it.

title: For the Love of Ada
description: Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. As Ruth appears to be going into labour, Ada and Walter are troubled in their new home by the presence of a ghost. (S4, E.

title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
description: 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Michael Strong. Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal significant funds from THRUSH.

title: The Footage Detectives
description: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home.

title: Enemy At The Door
description: 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall & Emily Richard. On her father's death, Betty Ridge gets work as a cleaner for the Germans, meeting young soldier Erich.

title: My Cousin Rachel
description: 1952. Mystery. Directed by Henry Koster. Stars Olivia de Havilland, Richard Burton & Audrey Dalton. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is a murderess.

title: Look At Life The Sky's The Limit
description: 1963. A look at the aerobatics of the RAF and the civil flyers.

title: Fox
description: If It's Good Enough for New Orleans It's Good Enough for Clapham. 1980. Stars Larry Lamb & Bernard Hill. London turns out to say goodbye to Billy and his funeral is exactly as he would want it.

title: The Runaway Train
description: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts & Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train.
